featured_reviews.name: Ankita Upadhyay
featured_reviews.review_text: We had a wonderful experience at Shital Photo Studio Thane. The baby photoshoot was done very professionally and with great care, which made us feel comfortable throughout the session. The team was patient and handled everything beautifully. We absolutely loved the photos—they turned out amazing and exceeded our expectations. Thank you so much for capturing such precious moments so perfectly!
